title: OMP's automatic compaction on the RTX 5090 lane: snapcompact's native-resolution images are refused; declaring supportsImageDetailOriginal: false makes the compacted continuation serve
question: Why did v0.8.5's first candidate (638fa35f) fail the RTX 5090 macOS route at step 9, 'Session survives the server process', with 400 only input_image detail 'auto' is supported, when v0.8.4's route passed the same step, and what makes a compacted continuation serve?
answer: OMP 18.3.0-18.4.0 compacts a 131,072-token session on its own once it passes 131,072 minus 15%, 111,412 tokens. For a model that declares image input, its first available method is snapcompact, which archives earlier turns as PNG images requested at detail 'original'; NInfer serves only 'auto' and refuses the request. Step 9 seeds its session with the release's own documents, which grew from 332,331 bytes at v0.8.4's candidate to 343,205 bytes at 638fa35f and crossed the threshold on the continue turn. A mock that enforces NInfer's image-detail contract, calibrated to both lane observations, reproduced the refusal with OMP 18.4.0 and 18.3.5. With supportsImageDetailOriginal: false in the model's compat, OMP sent the same five images at 'auto'. Replayed on the RTX 5090 runtime, the 'original' request was refused in 9 ms and the 'auto' request completed with 26,075 input tokens and the exact nonce. A seed bounded to 200,000 ASCII bytes did not compact.

method.source_reading: In 18.3.0, 18.3.5 and 18.4.0 the default compaction method order is remote, snapcompact, handoff; remote needs a configured endpoint or provider-native compaction, and snapcompact is offered only when the model's input includes image (packages/coding-agent/src/session/compaction-methods.ts). packages/snapcompact/src/snapcompact.ts sends its frames at detail 'original'; packages/ai/src/providers/openai-shared.ts clampResponsesImageDetail degrades 'original' to 'auto' only when compat.supportsImageDetailOriginal is false. The threshold is contextWindow minus max(15% of contextWindow, 16,384) (packages/agent/src/compaction/compaction.ts).
method.reproduction: Step 9's two OMP commands (seed turn, then --continue), run from the candidate clone's root in an isolated HOME with examples/manual-tunnel/models.fragment.yml (baseUrl pointed at the mock) and fail-closed.yml, on macOS 26.6.1 arm64. The mock streams one text response per request, refuses any input_image whose detail is not 'auto' with NInfer's exact 400 body, and reports input tokens as prompt bytes divided by a fixed ratio plus 1,000 per image. The server restart was not simulated: OMP decides compaction from the reported usage alone.
method.calibration: At 3.1 bytes per token the mock reproduces both lane observations: v0.8.4's 332,331-byte seed did not compact (its accepted route passed step 9) and 638fa35f's 343,205-byte seed compacted into five images at 'original' (its route was refused). At 3.2 and 3.33 neither compacted; at 3.0 and 2.9 both did.
method.lane_replay: The two compacted continuation requests OMP 18.4.0 sent to the mock (with and without the flag) were replayed once each on the RTX 5090 runtime, image ghcr.io/alphastorm/ninfer-runtime@sha256:cd9e10b115bbf38df011b201dfdd37ec3b56613da39b2f1701334c8157236b78, with store false, prompt_cache_key removed, reasoning effort low and max_output_tokens 256, so the runtime kept no session.

observations.route_failure_matched: The refused request in the v0.8.5 acceptance carried 5 input_image parts at 'original' after an archived-transcript preamble, with 3 input items and no previous_response_id, the same shape the mock captured.

limits: The compaction decision was reproduced against a mock whose token count is calibrated to two lane observations, not the lane's tokenizer.
One replay per variant of one compacted continuation; snapcompact readback fidelity beyond this nonce, and repeated compactions in one session, were not measured.
The RTX 4090 fragment declares text input only, so snapcompact is not offered there; that lane was not tested.
